classification_rationale: The customer is asking when they can drop off equipment at the end of a rental, a standard return-logistics question.

draft.reply_body:
Hi Laura,

Thanks for letting us know the compact track loader rental is finished. You're welcome to bring it back to our Rovaniemi depot during our normal opening hours — no appointment needed for a standard drop-off.

Once we've checked the equipment in, your damage deposit will be refunded in full within five working days, as long as everything comes back undamaged and complete.

Let us know your planned drop-off day if you'd like us to have someone ready to check it in.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy
